memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system source store, roadmap-integration.sh is a monolithic executable (its own set -euo pipefail, never sourced) -- unlike scripts/lib/file-scope-overlap.sh, it exports no splice-able defs variable. A consumer needing its detect_layout()-style classic/stage discrimination must re-implement the small, already-fully-specified structural predicate from context/formats/roadmap-format.md rather than source or splice the script.

context/patterns/roadmap-update.md's 'Live Callers' section is a live, load-bearing forward-pointer: it names roadmap-integration.sh's single live command caller (the /orchestrate conclusion stage, Step 5) and explicitly anticipates a planned advisory lint over hand-authored '## Next' batch proposals 'as dependent work elsewhere' -- the strongest textual confirmation of where such a lint is expected to hook, worth checking before assuming a call site needs to be invented from scratch.

scripts/lint/*.sh in agent-system/extensions/core is not uniformly wired into verify-deploy.sh: as of 2026-11-11, 3 of 22 lint scripts (lint-json-channel-discipline.sh, lint-test-harness-adoption.sh, lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh) are registered in manifest.json and tested but deliberately not part of the verify-deploy.sh battery. An unwired lint script (e.g. one whose subject is a consumer repo's specs/ROADMAP.md rather than the source store/deploy itself) already has live precedent and is not a novel shape requiring justification.
